subject: expression: fail `ColumnSubstituteImpl` if creating function returns error (#53716)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: `pkg/expression/util.go` now uses `NewFunction` and treats any error as substitution failure (returns original `*ScalarFunction` and sets `hasFail=true`), avoiding nil expressions/panics from `NewFunctionInternal`. Checked key callers that pass `fail1Return=true` (predicate pushdown/cascades selection pushdown/agg pushdown): they all bail out on `hasFailed`, so the change only disables the optimization on error rather than changing SQL semantics. Later history on `upstream/master` retains the same error-handling approach (no follow-up fix needed).
